valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD NYSE listing, no ADR conversion. Anchors: FY2025 adjusted EPS $7.54; FY2026 guidance $8.29-$8.44 (midpoint $8.37, +11%, includes $0.18 currency tailwind; currency-neutral +7.5% to 9.5%); Q3 adjusted EPS $2.36 (+5.4%), Q3 adjusted operating margin 44.7%; organic revenue growth guide 5-7%, organic operating income 7-9%. FY2027 EPS is my own assumption; the company gave no 2027 guidance in the Q3 release.

bear.driver: Currency tailwind reverses, ZYN/IQOS growth slows toward the low end of 5-7% organic revenue, combinable-cigarette decline steepens; staples and nicotine de-rate.

base.driver: Organic operating income growth near the 7-9% guide with buybacks offset by flat currency; EPS grows about 9% from $8.37; multiple roughly holds at the current level.

bull.driver: Smoke-free volume and margin expansion beyond 45% plus favorable FX lift EPS about 13.5%; premium growth multiple persists.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $9.10 the $198.96 close implies 21.9x; the equal-weight average of the seven pre-close named targets ($215.9) implies 23.7x on $9.10, or about $9.81 EPS at 22x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $9.10 (about 4.6 pp of the close).
valuation.watch_metric: Smoke-free (ZYN, IQOS) net revenue growth and organic operating income growth against the 7-9% guide, plus adjusted operating margin (Q3 2026: 44.7%).
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results with initial 2027 guidance, expected February 2027 (date not confirmed).

analyst_notes: Seven named analysts with dated calls since the Oct 21 earnings release: five Buys (BofA, Stifel, Barclays, Goldman, Argus) and two Holds (UBS, J.P. Morgan initiation). Targets run $200-$232, equal-weight average $215.9 versus the $198.96 close (about +8.5%), against my base of $200.2 (+0.6%); the roughly 8 pp gap equals about 0.7x of P/E at $9.10 EPS (23.7x vs 22x) or about $0.8 more EPS at 22x; no broker's assumptions were verified. Four targets were raised after earnings (Stifel +$27, UBS +$8, Argus +$10, BofA +$2); none has a documented 12-month horizon, so none enters the weighted target. The BTIG raise to $225 on Nov 17 is after the reference close and excluded. Coverage is a single aggregator table, so the sample may be incomplete. Dividend is the $6.40 annualized rate ($1.60 quarterly).
